question: How can a fictional field-notes team keep an offline index trustworthy?
audience: fictional editors testing an offline note-index workflow

subquestions.text: What does the fictional handbook require for an index entry?

candidate.title: One reviewed trail per index entry
candidate.problem: Fictional notes can lose their evidence trail
unanswered_questions: No real field team, archive or site was observed

subquestions.text: Does a screenshot alone establish a note's context?

sources.title: Synthetic Field Notes Handbook
sources.content: Synthetic Field Notes Handbook, fictional edition 0.1. The handbook asks every fictional note-taker to keep one reviewed trail for every index entry. A reviewer records the source label, the reading date, and the exact excerpt before an entry can be cited. A screenshot alone does not establish the context of a note. An unreviewed draft cannot be cited as a handbook fact.
